| h[n] | -0.0061 | -0.0136 | 0.0512 | 0.2657 | 0.4057 | 0.2657 | 0.0512 | -0.0136 | -0.0061 |

Nine Hamming taps for the cutoff 0.2 cycles per pixel. They are symmetric around n = 4 and add up to 1, so flat areas keep their value. The outer taps are negative, which is where ringing comes from.
